about: Support questions for a made-up online shop selling homeware and small electronics. Every question in an intent is answered by that intent's answer; questions in different intents need different answers. Written and labelled by reading, before any embedding code existed (docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, section 5a). Changes after the first run go in bench/CHANGES.md.

near_miss_kinds.amount: the same question about a different amount
near_miss_kinds.negation: the same question with a 'not' that flips the answer
near_miss_kinds.swapped: the same question about a different thing
near_miss_kinds.timing: the same question before or after something happens
near_miss_kinds.same-verb: the same verb about a different thing
